name: Human vs. AI-Rewritten Bengali Text Detection Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset of 4,008 labeled Bengali text samples (2,004 authentic human-written texts from NCTB textbooks, literature, and news portals, paired with 2,004 AI-rewritten texts generated using LLMs). Structured for binary classification and synthetic text detection.

provenance.collection_method: Human texts collected from NCTB textbooks, literature, and news portals; AI counterparts generated via prompt-based LLM rewriting.
provenance.curation_notes: Balanced 50/50 split across human and AI-rewritten classes with text length and stylistic parity.
